> Raw audio format definition for Membrane Multimedia Framework

## Pages

## Modules

- [Membrane.RawAudio](https://membrane-raw-audio-format.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RawAudio.md): This module contains a definition and related functions for struct `t:Membrane.RawAudio.t/0`,
describing a format of raw audio stream with interleaved channels.

- [Membrane.RawAudio.SampleFormat](https://membrane-raw-audio-format.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RawAudio.SampleFormat.md): This module defines sample formats used in `Membrane.RawAudio`
and some helpers to deal with them.
